name: theta-chain-panel
notes: The date-partitioned cross-section panel of ADR-0265 (Amendment 3), the input of the H1 and H3 documents: for every landed root, ChainDayFeatures run on that root ALONE (memory is one root, symbol_contiguous, max_symbol_rows refuses a root too big to hold), written as /home/russell/data/index_options/theta-research-20261012/chain-panel/roots/<root>.parquet (resumable per root: a root whose contributing snapshot files, feature params, rates table, bounds, rename map and gate values are unchanged is skipped) and then cut into panel/<YYYY-MM-DD>.parquet, one small file per date holding one row per (symbol, target DTE), sorted by symbol and target, with manifest.json (sha256 of every file) written last so the directory registers as a localblobs stream. The features are those of run-theta-chain-features-parquet.json (30- and 90-day targets, our Black-76 vols from NBBO mids on the parity forward, FRED DGS3MO as of strictly before the quote date; vendor greeks and implied_vol are never read). UNIVERSE GATE HOOKS: first_quote_date and after_first_quote come from the export's first_quote.json (first date a symbol has a real quote), liquidity_tercile from the census (run-theta-chain-census-parquet.json, development years only); they are carried as columns, never applied - a test chooses its universe, and both are whole-sample numbers a test must recompute up to its own start. READ-ONLY on /home/russell/data/thetadata/parquet-v2/options-tested/theta; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata. SEALED PERIOD: end_before and sealed_from 2026-01-01 on the reader, end_before on the features node. Run from children/index_options, roots then dates: nice -n 10 python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-theta-chain-panel.json --asof 2025-12-31; rerun after more snapshots land (only the changed roots are rebuilt). The panel directory is panel/ (date files and manifest.json together, swapped in whole by two renames, so a crash leaves the previous panel).

outputs.notes: A new directory beside the other research runs; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata. Excluded from the identity hash.

chain.notes: The ThetaData daily chain from the Parquet export tree, every root, symbol by symbol with dates ascending, projected to the ten fields the features read; the newest-acquired copy of a (symbol, date) unit wins. Lazy, re-iterable, read-only. The panel node asks it for one root at a time (select), so a root's files are read when that root is built and not before.

panel.notes: D9: census liquidity uses 2016-2018 only; census_asof 2019-01-01 keeps terciles null before 2019. Features and stale-spot rules are unchanged. A bounded pre-2026 rate source is required before any run: the legacy ObservationRows path is blocked by the owner's strict no-read seal.

summary.notes: evidence.md renders the roots built / skipped / empty, the rows and dates, the status counts per target, the quote exclusions and the reader counters.

rates_raw.notes: The FRED 3-month constant-maturity Treasury yield (DGS3MO, percent, dated by the observation date, '.' on a holiday) from the index_options onboarding root, read-only. The series runs to 2026-09, so the node below drops 2026 before anything joins it.

rates.notes: Sealed period and holidays: a 2026 observation never reaches the features node (which also refuses one), and a '.' (no print) is not a rate. The 2026 rows are parsed by the reader above and dropped here; the series is a macro rate, not option data.
